title: NEW SHERIFF IN TOWN
tagline_status: Current framed card's editorial caption; not a historical quotation
story: At dusk, a sheriff stands beside a fresh notice on a timber wall. An older wanted poster still peeks out above it. Down the street, a blue dollar sign glows: this frontier already has money, merchants and unfinished business.

On 18 July 2025, President Donald Trump signed the GENIUS Act into law. Its subject was payment stablecoins: digital assets designed for payment or settlement, with an issuer's obligation to redeem them for a fixed monetary value. The law established a framework for their issuance and supervision, including federal and qualifying state regulatory paths.

For permitted issuers, the Act sets requirements for at least one-to-one backing with specified liquid reserves, public redemption policies and monthly disclosures of reserve composition. Behind the familiar promise of a stable value, Congress set out concrete obligations about the assets held and the information customers could see.

Signing began a new chapter rather than completing the rollout. Rulemaking and the Act's effective-date provisions left implementation work ahead, and payment stablecoins were not made government-guaranteed money. The notice on this wall names a specific part of the market, not every token in town.
The hundredth card leaves the street open beyond the porch. A new rulebook has arrived; the frontier continues.

eggs.title: THE SHERIFF'S STAR
eggs.text: A plain gold star catches the sunset against the navy coat. The new sheriff gives regulatory oversight a familiar frontier face.

eggs.title: THE NOTICE ON THE WALL
eggs.text: GENIUS ACT, PAYMENT STABLECOINS and 18 JUL 2025 keep the event, statutory subject and signing date visible together.

eggs.title: THE OLDER WANTED POSTER
eggs.text: The Cryptoqueen from 044 reappears on the WANTED poster behind the new notice. This collection callback brings an earlier unresolved story onto the final card's wall.

eggs.title: THE BLUE DOLLAR SIGN
eggs.text: A small neon dollar glows farther down the street, linking the Western setting to digital money while keeping the sheriff and notice in the foreground.

art_note: The sheriff, town and posted notices are a fictional Western metaphor, not a signing ceremony or an official enforcement notice. The caption is editorial.
